# Load Libraries and Define Colors
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(rstatix)
library(Cairo)
library(ggbeeswarm) 



my_color_group <- c(
  "LPS+oxLDL" = "#ff6b6d",
  "oxLDL"     = "#ffa725",
  "LPS"       = "#A6CEE3",
  "Control"   = "lightgrey"
)

# Shared group level order used across all figures
group_levels_all <- c(
  "nonPMC", "nonPMC+LPS", "nonPMC+oxLDL", "nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL",
  "PMC",    "PMC+LPS",    "PMC+oxLDL",    "PMC+LPS+oxLDL"
)

# Shared group recode mapping
group_recode <- c(
  "Non.PMC.Control"   = "nonPMC",
  "Non.PMC.LPS"       = "nonPMC+LPS",
  "Non.PMC.oxLDL"     = "nonPMC+oxLDL",
  "Non.PMC.LPS.oxLDL" = "nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL",
  "PMC.Control"       = "PMC",
  "PMC.LPS"           = "PMC+LPS",
  "PMC.oxLDL"         = "PMC+oxLDL",
  "PMC.LPS.oxLDL"     = "PMC+LPS+oxLDL"
)
```


# Load and Reshape ELISA Data (Figures 7A–B)
```{r load_elisa_data}
dat <- data.frame(read.csv("Figure 7A-B ELISAs of cytokines.csv"))

dat_long <- dat %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample = X) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c("Non.PMC.Control", "Non.PMC.LPS", "Non.PMC.oxLDL", "Non.PMC.LPS.oxLDL",
                  "PMC.Control",     "PMC.LPS",     "PMC.oxLDL",     "PMC.LPS.oxLDL"),
    names_to  = "Group",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract treatment condition from group name
    Treatment = case_when(
      endsWith(Group, ".LPS.oxLDL") ~ "LPS+oxLDL",
      endsWith(Group, ".oxLDL")     ~ "oxLDL",
      endsWith(Group, ".LPS")       ~ "LPS",
      endsWith(Group, ".Control")   ~ "Control",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Extract cell type from group name
    CellType = case_when(
      startsWith(Group, "Non.PMC") ~ "in vitro Mφ",
      startsWith(Group, "PMC")     ~ "in vitro PMC Mφ",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Recode day labels
    Day = case_when(
      startsWith(as.character(Day), "7") ~ "6d",
      startsWith(as.character(Day), "4") ~ "72 hrs",
      TRUE                               ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```


# Figure 7A: TGF-β and IL-10 ELISA Bar Plots
```{r Figure_7A}
# Filter to IL-10 and TGFb and apply factor levels
dat_1 <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Cytokine %in% c("IL10", "TGFb")) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode_factor(
      factor(Group, levels = names(group_recode)),
      !!!group_recode
    )
  )
dat_1$Treatment <- factor(dat_1$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "LPS", "oxLDL", "LPS+oxLDL"))
dat_1$Group     <- factor(dat_1$Group,     levels = group_levels_all)
dat_1$Cytokine  <- factor(dat_1$Cytokine,  levels = c("TGFb", "IL10"))
dat_1$Day       <- factor(dat_1$Day,       levels = c("72 hrs", "6d"))

# Compute group means and standard errors
dat_s <- dat_1 %>%
  group_by(Group, Day, Cytokine, Treatment, CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# Tukey HSD post-hoc test; filter to biologically meaningful comparisons
pvals <- dat_1 %>%
  group_by(Day, Cytokine) %>%
  tukey_hsd(Expression ~ Group) %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-")) %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(p_label = sprintf("p<%1.2g", round(p.adj, 3) + 1e-3)) %>%
  filter(comparison %in% c(
    "nonPMC-PMC",
    "nonPMC+LPS-PMC+LPS",
    "nonPMC+oxLDL-PMC+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL-PMC+LPS+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+LPS",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL",
    "PMC-PMC+LPS",
    "PMC-PMC+oxLDL",
    "PMC-PMC+LPS+oxLDL"
  ))

# Build staggered bracket positions for significance annotations
brackets <- dat_s %>%
  group_by(Day, Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(mean_expr + se), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = c("Day", "Cytokine")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group1), !is.na(group2)) %>%
  distinct(Day, Cytokine, group1, group2, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    bracket_id = row_number(),
    y.position = max_y * (1.10 + bracket_id * 0.10),  # Stagger bracket heights
    xmin       = group1,
    xmax       = group2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p1 <- ggplot(dat_s, aes(x = Group, y = mean_expr, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_expr - se, ymax = mean_expr + se),
    width    = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
    color    = "grey"
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    data       = brackets,
    label      = "p_label",
    xmin       = "xmin",
    xmax       = "xmax",
    y.position = "y.position",
    size       = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_color_group) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  xlab("") + ylab("pg/mL") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Day + Cytokine, scales = "free_y")
p1
```


# Figure 7B: Pro-inflammatory Cytokine ELISA Bar Plots (Day 6)
```{r Figure_7B}
# Filter to day 6 and pro-inflammatory cytokines (exclude IL-10 and TGFb)
dat_1 <- dat_long %>%
  filter(Day == "6d") %>%
  filter(!Cytokine %in% c("IL10", "TGFb")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Expression)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = recode_factor(
      factor(Group, levels = names(group_recode)),
      !!!group_recode
    )
  )
dat_1$Treatment <- factor(dat_1$Treatment, levels = c("LPS", "LPS+oxLDL"))
dat_1$Cytokine  <- factor(dat_1$Cytokine,  levels = c("TNFa", "IL1b", "IL6"))

# Compute group means and standard errors
dat_s <- dat_1 %>%
  group_by(Group, Day, Cytokine, Treatment, CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# Tukey HSD; keep all significant comparisons
pvals <- dat_1 %>%
  group_by(Day, Cytokine) %>%
  tukey_hsd(Expression ~ Group) %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-")) %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(p_label = sprintf("p<%1.2g", round(p.adj, 3) + 1e-3))

# Build staggered bracket positions
brackets <- dat_s %>%
  group_by(Day, Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(mean_expr + se), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = c("Day", "Cytokine")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group1), !is.na(group2)) %>%
  distinct(Day, Cytokine, group1, group2, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    bracket_id = row_number(),
    y.position = max_y * (1.10 + bracket_id * 0.10),  # Stagger bracket heights
    xmin       = group1,
    xmax       = group2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p2 <- ggplot(dat_s, aes(x = Group, y = mean_expr, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_expr - se, ymax = mean_expr + se),
    width    = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
    color    = "grey"
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    data       = brackets,
    label      = "p_label",
    xmin       = "xmin",
    xmax       = "xmax",
    y.position = "y.position",
    size       = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_color_group) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  xlab("") + ylab("pg/mL") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Day + Cytokine, scales = "free_y")
p2
```


# Assemble and Save Figure 7A–B
```{r Figure_7AB_save}
p <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1.8, 1))
p
ggsave("Figure 7A-B.pdf", plot = p, width = 25, height = 8)
```


# Figure 7C: Flow Cytometry Functional Marker Bar Plots
```{r Figure_7C}
dat <- data.frame(read.csv("Figure 7C Flow cytometry of fuctional markers.csv"))
dat <- dat[, 1:10] %>% na.omit()

# Reshape from wide to long format
dat_long <- dat %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample = X) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c("Non.PMC.Control", "Non.PMC.LPS", "Non.PMC.oxLDL", "Non.PMC.LPS.oxLDL",
                  "PMC.Control",     "PMC.LPS",     "PMC.oxLDL",     "PMC.LPS.oxLDL"),
    names_to  = "Group",
    values_to = "Expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract treatment condition from group name
    Treatment = case_when(
      endsWith(Group, ".LPS.oxLDL") ~ "LPS+oxLDL",
      endsWith(Group, ".oxLDL")     ~ "oxLDL",
      endsWith(Group, ".LPS")       ~ "LPS",
      endsWith(Group, ".Control")   ~ "Control",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Extract cell type from group name
    CellType = case_when(
      startsWith(Group, "Non.PMC") ~ "in vitro Mφ",
      startsWith(Group, "PMC")     ~ "in vitro PMC Mφ",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # Recode group labels
    Group = recode(Group, !!!group_recode)
  )

dat_long$Treatment <- factor(dat_long$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "LPS", "oxLDL", "LPS+oxLDL"))
dat_long$Group     <- factor(dat_long$Group,     levels = group_levels_all)
dat_long$Gene      <- factor(dat_long$Gene,      levels = sort(unique(dat_long$Gene)))

# Compute group means and standard errors
dat_s <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(Group, Gene, Treatment, CellType) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n         = n(),
    se        = sd(Expression,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# Tukey HSD; filter to biologically meaningful comparisons
pvals <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  tukey_hsd(Expression ~ Group) %>%
  mutate(comparison = paste(group1, group2, sep = "-")) %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(p_label = sprintf("p<%1.2g", round(p.adj, 3) + 1e-3)) %>%
  filter(comparison %in% c(
    "nonPMC-PMC",
    "nonPMC+LPS-PMC+LPS",
    "nonPMC+oxLDL-PMC+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL-PMC+LPS+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+LPS",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+oxLDL",
    "nonPMC-nonPMC+LPS+oxLDL",
    "PMC-PMC+LPS",
    "PMC-PMC+oxLDL",
    "PMC-PMC+LPS+oxLDL"
  ))

# Build staggered bracket positions (scaled per gene's y-range)
brackets <- dat_s %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(max_y = max(mean_expr + se, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(pvals, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(group1), !is.na(group2)) %>%
  distinct(Gene, group1, group2, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    bracket_id = row_number(),
    y.position = max_y + bracket_id * max_y * 0.15,  # Stagger heights relative to each gene's max
    xmin       = group1,
    xmax       = group2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p3 <- ggplot(dat_s, aes(x = Group, y = mean_expr, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_expr - se, ymax = mean_expr + se),
    width    = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
    color    = "grey"
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    data       = brackets,
    label      = "p_label",
    xmin       = "xmin",
    xmax       = "xmax",
    y.position = "y.position",
    size       = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_color_group) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  xlab("") + ylab("MFI Fold Change") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))
p3

ggsave("Figure 7C.pdf", plot = p3, width = 22, height = 12)
```

# Figure 8
```{r}
my_color_PMC = c("in vitro Mφ"="#529AC9","in vitro PMC Mφ" = "#CC4A74")
#Figure 
dat <- readxl::read_xlsx("./Data availability/Figure 8 EndMT.xlsx",sheet = 1)
dat_long <- dat %>%
  filter(Y_axis=="Relative fold change") %>%
  pivot_longer(
        cols = c("Non_PMC", "PMC"),
        names_to = "Group",
        values_to = "Expression"
      )%>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Group = dplyr::recode(
        Group,
        "Non_PMC" = "in vitro Mφ",
        "PMC"  = "in vitro PMC Mφ"
      )
    )

Fig8_A <- ggplot(dat_long, aes(x = Group, y = Expression, fill = Group)) +
  geom_violin(width = 0.2, alpha = 1, aes(color = Group)) +
  geom_quasirandom(size = 0.1,alpha = 1,color = "grey40")+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 1, color="lightgrey",linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_color_PMC) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_color_PMC) +
  facet_wrap(~ Marker, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  # paired t-test with p-value adjustment (BH) and formatted labels
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "t.test",
    comparisons = list(c("in vitro Mφ", "in vitro PMC Mφ")),
    paired = TRUE,
    p.adjust.method = "fdr",
    label = "p.adj",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative Fold Expression") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0.1, 0)) 

Fig8_A
```
